author: Your man Zack
title: Bigger maps!
content:
CODM is looking better than ever, but the maps need some work 💀

Please give us bigger maps. Not Houston, Texas-sized maps 😂, just make some of the current maps wider and give us more room to move.

Shoot House would be WAY better if you widened it out, removed some of the cars/objects blocking everything, and added a few more routes around the sides. Same with some of the smaller maps where you literally just run straight into the enemy with nowhere to hide or flank.

Also, give us more street-fighting/urban maps with actual city streets, buildings, alleys, rooftops, parking garages, and multiple ways to move around.

And please rework those tiny one-way train-station-style maps 💀. If the entire match is basically “run straight → shoot → die → repeat,” that’s not very fun. Give us multiple lanes, more cover, and different routes.

Also:
• More guns
• Better weapon balancing
• Bigger/more detailed BR maps
• Better matchmaking
• Fix lag and frame drops
• More original content
• Better map variety

The graphics and weapon designs are getting crazy good. Now give the maps the same treatment. 🔥

However, Zombies needs more attention and content. I’d love to see more maps, bosses, zombie types, perks, weapons, Easter eggs, challenges, and customization.

author: Cod mobile overall
title: Cod mobile overall
content:
It’s decent shooting game, but for COD and it being 2026 I would expect it to be more by now. 
It still glitches/lags often and the gameplay could be better, I’ve had my account well over 2 years now and still constantly get bot matches that aren’t really fun at all. The game barely gives you anything for actually playing or completing events or challenges and everything cost like 20$+ if you want to buy something, in my opinion, for a mobile game that’s a bit excessive. 
When you finally load and open the game you have to close out of about 10 pop ups try to make you spend money or do some random event/challenge going on with bad prizes. 
The same maps on BR and MP, have been being used for like 4 years already and just get reused in rotation and it just gets old and boring, I really wish they would make and use some new maps already. 
A better game IS possible I’m not sure why they haven’t fixed it yet, I think of Fortnite when it went mobile and it was exactly like console also when they made warzone mobile it was a little better than this. This game cod mobile is something that would come out in like year 2017, it’s outdated and needs and whole new look.

content: I have enjoyed the game for quite awhile DESPITE the exasperating issues that follow… Unfortunately there doesn’t seem to be serious competition for it so we’re stuck with it! Issue #4 (nothing new) how you can never kill someone with a melee weapon (knife, spear, boxing gloves) with your machine gun, yet the enemy can kill you with a punch to any part of the body… C’mon guys! Really? Other than all these frustrating issues, it is entertaining.

author: Cristian paiko
title: You Betrayed Veteran Players
content:
I have supported Call of Duty: Mobile since 2019, and bringing back Ghost – Plasma is one of the most disappointing decisions you have ever made.

For years, this skin was rare, meaningful, and a symbol of being an original player. Whenever people saw it in a match, they recognized it and complimented me because it showed that I had supported the game from the beginning. It had a special presence and history that very few skins could match.

Now, simply because many players wanted it, you brought it back and destroyed everything that made it special. This sends a terrible message to longtime players: nothing we purchase has lasting value, rarity, or meaning. Why should anyone spend money on limited-time content if players who missed it can simply obtain it years later?

You rewarded those who waited while taking away the value from those who supported the game early. Decisions like this destroy trust and remove any reason to keep spending money. Ghost – Plasma was more than just another cosmetic—it represented history, loyalty, and pride. Now that has been erased.

At the very least, original owners should receive an exclusive OG version, special effect, or badge. Until veteran players and their purchases are respected, spending money on this game no longer feels worthwhile.
